scope: Camera laboratory continuous spectral integration; local source and default Release output

implementation.illuminantUnits: Absolute ideal-white image-plane spectral irradiance, W/m^2/nm
implementation.reflectanceUnits: Fraction 0–1, or explicitly labeled percent converted to fraction
implementation.spatialScene: One material reflectance spectrum, modulated by linear grayscale .2126R+.7152G+.0722B
implementation.quadrature: Merged input knots plus bounded subdivision, 3-point Gauss-Legendre per interval
implementation.optics: Shared Core PSF, distortion and relative illumination at every quadrature wavelength, or explicit ideal optical control
implementation.sensor: Integrate expected charge before a single shared noise/full-well/ADC/ISP operation
implementation.denseIdealOptics: Identity optical transfer sums spectral coefficients once before applying the spatial mask, preserving all knots without pixel-times-node work
export: Existing sensor-profile.json, QE, RAW and PNG files
